H4500.def: from «05214»; a yoke (properly, for plowing), i.e. the frame of a loom:--beam.

H4501.def: or mnorah {men-o-raw'}; feminine of «04500» (in the original sense of «05216»); a chandelier:--candlestick.

H4503.et: from an unused root meaning to apportion, i.e. bestow
H4503.def: from an unused root meaning to apportion, i.e. bestow; a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary):--gift, oblation, (meat) offering, present, sacrifice.

H4504.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04503»; a sacrificial offering:--oblation, meat offering.

H4506.def: from «05117»; rest; Manachath, the name of an Edomite and of a place in Moab:--Manahath.

H4507.def: from «04487»; the Apportioner, i.e. Fate (as an idol):--number.

H4508.def: of foreign derivation; Minni, an Armenian province:--Minni.

H4509.def: from «04480» and «03225»; from (the) right hand; Minjamin, the name of two Israelites:--Miniamin. Compare «04326».

H4511.def: from the same as «04482»; enumeration; Minnith, a place East of the Jordan:--Minnith.

H4513.def: a primitive root; to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury:--deny, keep (back), refrain, restrain, withhold.

H4517.def: from «05128»; a sistrum (so called from its rattling sound):--cornet.

H4518.def: from «05352»; a sacrificial basin (for holding blood):--bowl.

H4519.def: from «05382»; causing to forget; Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:--Manasseh.

H4520.def: from «04519»; a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh:--of Manasseh, Manassites.

H4521.def: from «04487»; an allotment (by courtesy, law or providence):--portion.

H4522.def: or mic {mees}; from «04549»; properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor:--discomfited, levy, task(-master), tribute(-tary).

H4524.def: plural masculine mcibbiym {mes-ib-beem'}; or feminine mcibbowth {mes-ib-bohth'}; from «05437»; a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around:--that compass about, (place) round about, at table.

H4525.def: from «05462»; a fastener, i.e. (of a person) a smith, (of a thing) a prison:--prison, smith.

H4526.def: from «05462»; something enclosing, i.e. a margin (of a region, of a panel); concretely, a stronghold:--border, close place, hole.

H4528.def: from the same as «05468»; a colonnade or internal portico (from its rows of pillars):--porch.

H4529.def: a primitive root; to dissolve:--make to consume away, (make to) melt, water.

H4530.def: from «04549» (in the sense of flowing); abundance, i.e. (adverbially) liberally: tribute.

H4531.def: from «05254»; a testing, of men (judicial) or of God (querulous):--temptation, trial.

H4532.def: the same as «04531»; Massah, a place in the Desert:--Massah.

H4533.et: apparently from an unused root meaning to cover
H4533.def: apparently from an unused root meaning to cover; a veil:--vail.

H4535.et: from (05255) in the sense of staving off
H4535.def: from «05255» in the sense of staving off; a cordon, (adverbially) or (as a) military barrier:--broken down.

H4537.def: a primitive root; to mix, especially wine (with spices):--mingle.

H4538.def: from «04537»; a mixture, i.e. of wine with spices:--mixture.

H4539.def: from «05526»; a cover, i.e. veil:--covering, curtain, hanging.

H4541.def: from «05258»; properly, a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication, a libation, i.e. league; concretely a coverlet (as if poured out):--covering, molten (image), vail.

H4543.def: by transp. from «03664»; a magazine: --store(-house), treasure.

H4545.et: from (05259) in the sense of spreading out
H4545.def: from «05259» in the sense of spreading out; something expanded, i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof):--web.

H4546.def: from «05549»; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked), literally or figuratively; specifically a viaduct, a staircase:--causeway, course, highway, path, terrace.

H4548.def: or micmer {mis-mare'}; also (feminine) macmrah {mas-mer-aw'}; or micmrah {mis-mer-aw'}; or even masmrah (Eccles. 12:11) {mas-mer-aw'}; from «05568»; a peg (as bristling from the surface):--nail.

H4549.def: a primitive root; to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief):--discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, × utterly.

H4550.def: from «05265»; a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure):--journey(-ing).

H4551.et: from (05265) in the sense of projecting
H4551.def: from «05265» in the sense of projecting; a missile (spear or arrow); also a quarry (whence stones are, as it were, ejected):--before it was brought, dart.

H4553.def: from «05594»; a lamentation:--lamentation, one mourneth, mourning, wailing.

H4554.et: from an unused root meaning to collect
H4554.def: from an unused root meaning to collect; fodder:--provender.

H4556.def: from «05596»; scruf (as spreading over the surface):--scab.

H4557.def: from «05608»; a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration:--+ abundance, account, × all, × few, (in-)finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, + time.

H4558.def: the same as «04457»; number; Mispar, an Israelite:--Mizpar. Compare «04559».

H4559.def: feminine of «04437»; enumeration; Mispereth, an Israelite:--Mispereth. Compare «04458».

H4560.def: a primitive root; to sunder, i.e. (transitively) set apart, or (reflex.) apostatize:--commit, deliver.

H4564.def: from «05641»; properly, a hider, i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion:--hid.

H4565.def: from «05641»; properly, a concealer, i.e. a covert:--secret(-ly, place).

H4568.def: from «05666»; properly, compact (part of soil), i.e. loam:--clay.

H4569.def: or feminine mapabarah {mah-ab-aw-raw'}; from «05674»; a crossing-place (of a river, a ford; of a mountain, a pass); abstractly, a transit, i.e. (figuratively) overwhelming:--ford, place where...pass, passage.

H4570.def: or feminine mapgalah {mah-gaw-law'}; from the same as «05696»; a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular):--going, path, trench, way((-side)).

H4571.def: a primitive root; to waver:--make to shake, slide, slip.

H4573.def: from «05710» and «03050»; ornament of Jah; Maadjah, an Israelite:--Maadiah. Compare «04153».

H4574.def: or (feminine) maadannah {mah-ad-an-naw'}; from «05727»; a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially, cheerfully):--dainty, delicately, delight.

H4575.def: by transitive from «06029»; a bond, i.e. group:--influence.

H4577.def: (Aramaic) or m(ae (Aramaic) {meh-aw'}; corresponding to «04578»; only in plural the bowels:--belly.

H4578.et: from an unused root probably meaning to be soft
H4578.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be soft; used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extens. the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively):--belly, bowels, × heart, womb.

H4579.def: feminine of «04578»; the belly, i.e. (figuratively) interior:--gravel.

H4580.def: from «05746»; a cake of bread (with «03934» a table- buffoon, i.e. parasite):--cake, feast.

H4581.def: (also mauwz {maw-ooz'}); or mahoz {maw-oze'} (also ma,uz {maw-ooz'}; from «05810»; a fortified place; figuratively, a defence:--force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), (X most) strong (hold).

H4583.def: or maiyn (1 Chronicles 4:41) {maw-een'}; from the same as «05772»; an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum):--den, dwelling((-)place), habitation.

H4584.def: the same as «04583»; a residence; Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Maon, Maonites. Compare «01010», «04586».

H4585.def: or msonah {meh-o-naw'}; feminine of «04583», and meaning the same:--den, habitation, (dwelling) place, refuge.

H4586.def: or Msiyniy {meh-ee-nee'}; probably patrial from «04584»; a Meunite, or inhabitant of Maon (only in plural):--Mehunim(-s), Meunim.

H4587.def: plural of «04585»; habitative; Meonothai, an Israelite:--Meonothai.

H4588.et: from (05774) in the sense of covering with shade [compare (04155)]
H4588.def: from «05774» in the sense of covering with shade (compare «04155»); darkness:--dimness.

H4589.def: from «05783»; nakedness, i.e. (in plural) the pudenda:--nakedness.

H4590.et: probably from (05756) (in the sense of protection) and (03050)
H4590.def: or Ma.azyahuw {mah-az-yaw'-hoo}; probably from «05756» (in the sense of protection) and «03050»; rescue of Jah; Maazjah, the name of two Israelites:--Maaziah.

H4591.def: a primitive root; properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; intransitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective):--suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, × borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gather least (little), be (seem) little, (X give the) less, be minished, bring to nothing.

H4592.def: or miat {meh-awt'}; from «04591»; a little or few (often adverbial or compar.):--almost (some, very) few(-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, × very.

H4593.def: passive adjective of «04591»; thinned (as to the edge), i.e. sharp:--wrapped up.

H4596.def: from «05753»; a pile of rubbish (as contorted), i.e. a ruin (compare «05856»):--heap.

H4597.def: probably from «04578»; sympathetic; Maai, an Israelite:--Maai.

H4598.et: from (04603) in the sense of covering
H4598.def: from «04603» in the sense of covering; a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment):--cloke, coat, mantle, robe.

H4599.et: from (05869) (as a denominative in the sense of a spring)
H4599.def: or ma ynow (Psa. 114:8) {mah-yen-o'}; or (feminine) ma yanah {mah-yaw-naw'}; from «05869» (as a denominative in the sense of a spring); a fountain (also collectively), figuratively, a source (of satisfaction):--fountain, spring, well.
